Persist exact Attempt cancellation authority (#134)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-43
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - Add provider-neutral cancellation request, receipt, identity snapshot, and late-callback audit contracts.
    - Persist cancellation authority transactionally in PostgreSQL, move active Attempts to `cancelling`, and advance the current dispatch fence.
    - Preserve completion-first ordering while rejecting and auditing cancel-first late completions without mutating Issue state.
    - Cover stale versions, terminal outcomes, profile isolation, concurrent replay, deterministic receipts, and completion races.
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker attempt_cancellation --lib`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker execution::tests --lib`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres postgres_state_mapping --lib`
    
    PostgreSQL acceptance tests compiled but could not execute because `CODEON_TEST_DATABASE_URL` was not configured. Focused Clippy is also blocked by two pre-existing warnings in untouched files.
    
    ## Scope
    
    Tracker cancellation contracts and PostgreSQL authority only. No provider adapters, daemon cancellation worker, filesystem behavior, or MCP surface changes.
